basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: AIIMS Bhopal has one Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post in an ICMR-funded research project, with applications open until 16 November 2026. Candidates with a Post Graduate degree, including an integrated PG degree, in the listed subjects can apply if they are not over 35 years of age. The post is purely temporary, with a tenure of 11 months. Applications go by email, and no application fee is charged.

age_limit.details: The age must not exceed 35 years as on the last date of application. The Terms and Conditions separately say that the effective date for eligibility and the upper age limit will be the date of the walk-in or written examination.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the AIIMS Bhopal website. Applications in any other format will be rejected.

Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before the last date.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Bhopal is at Saket Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. This recruitment is for a research project under Principal Investigator Dr. Sagar Khadanga, Additional Professor in the Department of General Medicine. The application form names the Department of Translational Medicine on its letterhead.

content_sections.heading: About the Project and Duties
content_sections.text: The project is titled "Multi-Omics Profiling and Population Pharmacokinetic Approach for Prediction of Drug Interactions and Adverse Drug Reactions for the Antitubercular Therapy (ATT) with Anti-Retroviral Therapy (ART), and Comedications." The job description lists these duties and expectations: Isolating genomic DNA, RNA and proteins from biological samples Isolating serum and plasma samples from blood samples Manuscript writing and publications Day-to-day mentoring of project staff and students Timely preparation of the progress report, financial report and manuscript Any other duties assigned by the PI/Co-I from time to time Being self-motivated, highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age must not exceed 35 years as on the last date of application. The Terms and Conditions separately say that the effective date for eligibility and the upper age limit will be the date of the walk-in or written examination. Post Graduate degree including integrated PG degree in Pharmacy, Pharm D, Life Sciences, Biotechnology and Biochemistry. This is the minimum qualification, and holding it does not by itself entitle a candidate to selection. Prior experience in pharmacogenomics, pharmacokinetics and molecular biology experiments Knowledge of adverse drug reaction (ADR) reporting and analysis Good communication and leadership skills Computer skills: GraphPad Prism, Excel, SPSS and "R" software Prior experience in tuberculosis or HIV research Prior publications in a relevant area (preferred) SC/ST/OBC/other candidates: as per ICMR guidelines. Retrenched Government Employees, Departmental candidates (including projects) and ex-servicemen: as per rule, in accordance with Central Government instructions issued from time to time. Experienced and skilled persons: concession to the extent of service rendered in research projects, as per the competent selection committee. Applications are invited from Indian nationals. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Candidates must make sure they meet the prescribed qualification and experience. A candidate who clears selection can still be disqualified at document verification if the essential criteria are not met. See the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Depending on the number of applications received, candidates will be shortlisted for a written test and/or interview. The recruitment will be conducted in offline mode only, and all shortlisted candidates must report for the interview physically. The test or interview date will be announced through a notification on the AIIMS Bhopal website, so applicants need to check the site regularly for dates, changes and the result.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The tenure is 11 months, on a purely temporary basis. The assignment is governed by the rules and instructions received from ICMR or the competent authority from time to time. The contract expires automatically at the end of the specified period unless it is renewed with mutual consent. Either side can end the appointment at any time with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu. Leave follows the ICMR leave policy governing extramural research projects. Private practice of any type is prohibited. The appointee must conform to the rules of conduct and discipline applicable to institute employees.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the AIIMS Bhopal website. Applications in any other format will be rejected. Fill in the form completely, including the contact details of two referees and a note on how your expertise would complement the project. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Combine the filled-up form and all relevant documents into a single PDF file. Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before the last date. Do not send a hard copy or printout. Duly filled application form with two passport size photographs Date of Birth Certificate (Class 12th/High School Certificate) Graduation Certificate and Marksheets Post-Graduation Certificate and Marksheets Registration Certificate with statutory council Caste Certificate, if any Copies of the first page of publications (best 5) Certificates of oral/poster presentations in national or international conferences (best 5) Certificate of relevant work experience from previous employers Any other document (to be specified) Candidates must also bring original certificates for age, educational or professional qualification and experience, along with one set of self-attested photocopies. The photographs must be recent and in colour. Without these documents, a candidate will not be allowed to take part in the test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. Can a Pharm D holder apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. Pharm D is named in the essential qualification, along with Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotechnology and Biochemistry.

faq.question: Q2. How much will the selected candidate earn?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 56,000 plus 20% HRA, which comes to Rs. 67,200 per month.

faq.question: Q3. Can this post lead to a PhD?
faq.answer: The notice says the post may be converted to a PhD program as per AIIMS Bhopal guidelines from time to time.

faq.question: Q4. Does this job give a right to a permanent post?
faq.answer: No. The appointment gives no right to claim regular appointment or permanent absorption in AIIMS Bhopal or ICMR, or continued contractual appointment.

faq.question: Q5. Where can the selected candidate be posted?
faq.answer: The candidate can be posted at any place as per the project's requirement, including rural areas and field sites.

faq.question: Q6. Will AIIMS Bhopal pay travel costs or provide a hostel?
faq.answer: No travelling or other allowance is paid for appearing in the written examination or for joining the post. The Institute and the Principal Investigator will not provide a hostel or any other accommodation.

faq.question: Q7. I am already in government service. What extra document do I need?
faq.answer: You must submit a No Objection Certificate from your present employer at the time of the written test or interview.

faq.question: Q8. What can lead to disqualification?
faq.answer: Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification. A candidate who gives false information or wilfully suppresses material information will be liable to be removed from service, and further action may be taken by the appointing authority.
